reasons: Cited Section 11.1 provides automatic renewal for successive one (1) year terms — not multi-year — with a mutual non-renewal notice window of thirty (30) days, which satisfies the preferred position on both renewal term length and exit notice and is far inside the 90-day walk-away threshold.

Exhibit B (p0153-p0154) fixes MarketSite.net access and maintenance/support fees for 'Year 2-5, and beyond,' so there is no renewal price-uplift mechanic requiring a CPI/3% cap; treating the missing vendor reminder and express uplift cap as noted sub-elements rather than deviations matches the playbook's classification semantics.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was applied and no counterparty comment was generated; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged.

The failed deterministic check ('number not found') is a regex artifact — the clause plainly states 'at least thirty (30) days prior,' which is within the ≤60-day requirement — so it does not undermine the substance of the finding.
